clips.title: The story
paras: Wizzle Brassbolts at the Mirage Raceway fears the rocket car is so fast that friction will tear it apart. To protect it, he needs tail fins from the Saltscale murlocs at the Vile Reef, off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale.

Wizzle calls the rocket car the fastest thing on the Shimmering Flats, and worries that friction will tear it apart. The moving parts need a coat of composite that is hard but not brittle, and able to resist salt corrosion, or the flats will eat the car away. Its key ingredient is the tail fins of the Saltscale murlocs, who live at the Vile Reef, off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale. You are asked to bring Wizzle ten of them.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Our rocket car is the fastest thing on the flats! So fast that... I'm afraid friction is going to tear it apart!

To prevent that I need to create a composite to coat the car's moving parts. It must be hard but not brittle, and must be resistant to salt corrosion, or time spent on the Shimmering Flats will eat it away.
Have you heard of the Vile Reef, friend? It's off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale. Saltscale murlocs live there, and their tail fins are a crucial ingredient of my composite.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the tail fins? If I can't protect our car from its own speed, then it won't last long in these races.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend! After I grind these down and fuse them with a few other ingredients, the composite will be ready. And after that, the car will be safe from its own speed.
Safe, as long as it doesn't hit anything...
